title: Neoswarm · An Agent Swarm for Power Users
excerpt: A terminal workspace where every feature is a plugin. Free, open source, held by its community.
content_html:
FAQ

Before you install it,
what people want to know.

Most of them have the same answer.

Open an issue

Yes, all of it. The sidebar, the panels, the keys, the colors. Every part of the interface is built on a public API, so a plugin can replace anything we ship with something of your own.

No. The defaults work out of the box. If you do know Neovim, the keys will feel familiar, and everything can be rebound the same way.

Yes. Plugins are written in TypeScript, and the API is fully typed. The features that ship with neosh are plugins themselves, so anything they can do, yours can too.

Yes. Every built-in feature is a plugin, and any plugin can be disabled or replaced in your config.

Your agents keep running. The workspace runs as its own process, and the terminal is just a window into it. Open it again later and everything is where you left it.

Yes. neosh is open source under the MIT license. You connect the AI accounts you already have.
